commands.git-commit-mode-menu: An easy-menu menu-bar menu; E8 has no menu bar, and the commands it lists are on git-commit-mode's keys.
commands.git-rebase-mode-menu: An easy-menu menu-bar menu; E8 has no menu bar, and the commands it lists are on git-rebase-mode's keys.
commands.magit-mode-menu: An easy-menu menu-bar menu; E8 has no menu bar, and the commands it lists are in magit-dispatch.
commands.magit-add-change-log-entry: Calls add-change-log-entry, and E8 has no add-log (ChangeLog files).
commands.magit-add-change-log-entry-other-window: Calls add-change-log-entry-other-window, and E8 has no add-log (ChangeLog files).
commands.magit-generate-changelog: Needs add-log's change-log-insert-entries, diff-mode's diff-add-log-current-defuns and vc-git, which E8 does not have.

options.magit-credential-cache-daemon-socket: E8 does not start git's credential cache daemon, which Magit starts for HTTPS remotes.
options.magit-cygwin-mount-points: E8 does not run on Cygwin or Windows, whose file names this translates.
options.magit-need-cygwin-noglob: E8 does not run on Cygwin or Windows, whose git globs arguments.
options.magit-git-output-coding-system: E8 has no coding systems: git's output is read as UTF-8.
options.magit-process-ensure-unix-line-ending: E8 has no coding systems: what is sent to git keeps its line endings.
options.magit-remote-git-executable: E8 has no remote files (TRAMP), so git always runs on this machine.
options.magit-revision-show-gravatars: E8 does not fetch gravatar images.
options.magit-view-git-manual-method: E8 has no Info reader, so there are no Info links to Git's manual to follow.
options.magit-region-highlight-hook: E8 has no redisplay-highlight-region-function, through which Magit draws a selection in place of the region.
options.magit-section-keep-region-overlay: E8 has no redisplay-highlight-region-function, through which Magit draws a selection in place of the region.
options.magit-diff-highlight-hunk-region-functio: E8 has no redisplay-highlight-region-function, through which Magit draws a hunk-internal region.
options.magit-diff-unmarked-lines-keep-foregroun: E8 has no redisplay-highlight-region-function, through which Magit draws a hunk-internal region.
